title: Stop Saying "I Got So Angry": 3 Better Ways #shorts
description:
Another word for angry? When someone cuts you off in traffic, you're not just angry. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Lose it: suddenly lose control and shout (informal)
• Fly off the handle: get very angry very fast (idiom)
• See red: get so angry you can't think straight (idiom)

Ever lost it in traffic like this?

Clip: Two Tars (1928)
